correctness.rationale: The centered independent Poisson/Gaussian specification has variance one exactly. Expanding its cumulant-generating function gives M(t)=1+sum_{n≥1}2[p+(1-p)(-b)^n]t^n/(n+2)!, with optimal right scale c=max(0,sup_{t>0}(1-1/M(t))/t). Its local coefficient m=[p-(1-p)b]/3 and sign of a_2-m^2 produce the explicit upper quadratic root p_*(b). For p≥p_*, positive coefficients obey a_(n+1)/a_n≤m via the uniform ratio bound; geometric-series domination proves global c=m, with strict inequality for positive t at the boundary. Below p_* the local derivative or positive upper jump forces a strict finite positive maximizer. Analytic implicit-function and a strict compact-away-from-zero gap prove local uniqueness and quadratic crossover; the rare-p asymptotic follows by splitting t at (1-eps)log(1/p) and testing t=log(1/p)+3loglog(1/p). Independently evaluated the MGF and variational profile on both sides of p_* for three b values (six phase tests); the b=0 coefficients evaluate exactly to 3/4,40/3,5/9. Fixed b<1 and only right variance-exact subgamma, not left-tail or b=1 new claim.
